{"metadata":{"description":"Universal Model Context Protocol (MCP) Bridge Plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — Everything is a Plugin","id":"gh:1342217251","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-plugin-mcp","slug":"menotbobbybrown/dsh-plugin-mcp","topics":["ai-agents","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","mcp","model-context-protocol"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Universal Model Context Protocol (MCP) Bridge Plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — Everything is a Pl"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ersal Model Context Protocol (MCP) Bridge Plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — Everything is a Plugin"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-plugin-mcp"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> **Universal Model Context Protocol (MCP) Bridge Plugin for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"`dsh-plugin-mcp` is an official-standard plugin for DeepSeek Harness that seamlessly connects your D"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"eepSeek agents to the entire ecosystem of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with full Claude Code"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"-level feature parity."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"See our complete ROADMAP.md for current features and upcoming milestones."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- 🔌 **Universal MCP Support**: Run any MCP server over `stdio`, `sse`, or `websocket`.
- 🚀 **10,000+"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" Server Scale Engine**: Dormant-by-default process pool with JIT worker activation and LRU idle proc"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ess reaper (maintains <100MB RAM even with 10k servers).
- ⚡ **Sub-Millisecond BM25 Inverted Index**"},{"id":"p7s4","text":": Evaluates 20,000+ tool definitions across thousands of servers in <0.5ms.
- 🎯 **Dynamic Token Budg"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"et Allocator**: Strict context window capping (e.g. max 1,500 tokens) with progressive schema disclo"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"sure.
- 💾 **Two-Tier Schema Cache (L1/L2)**: Instant memory cache + disk snapshot eliminates `tools/"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"list` handshake delay on boots.
- 📊 **Enterprise Telemetry**: High-resolution p50, p95, and p99 tool"},{"id":"p7s8","text":" latency histograms and metrics.
- 📁 **Multi-Scope Configurations**: Automatically loads user global"},{"id":"p7s9","text":" (`~/.dsh/mcp.json`), project local (`.dsh/mcp.json`), and profile-level configurations.
- 🛡️ **Exec"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"ution Permissions**: Granular `allow`, `ask`, and `deny` permission rules for tool safety.
- 🔒 **Ent"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"erprise Security Engine**: Automatic secrets redaction (API keys/bearer tokens), command injection g"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"uards, and path traversal defenses.
- 🚦 **Circuit Breaker & Rate Limiting**: Fault tolerance prevent"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"s runaway loops and token quota exhaustion on failing servers.
- 📜 **Security Audit Logging**: Struc"},{"id":"p7s14","text":"tured JSON logging of all tool invocations, permissions verdicts, and safety events.
- 🔍 **Semantic "},{"id":"p7s15","text":"Tool Search**: TF-IDF token relevance scoring ensures only relevant tools are injected into prompt c"},{"id":"p7s16","text":"ontext.
- 🗜️ **Context Spillover Guard**: Truncates massive outputs (>30k chars) and stores them as "},{"id":"p7s17","text":"local artifacts with structured previews.
- 🛠️ **Automatic Tool Bridging**: Dynamically registers MC"},{"id":"p7s18","text":"P tools into the DSH tool registry with JSON Schema validation.
- 📂 **Resource & Prompt Bridge**: Ex"},{"id":"p7s19","text":"poses MCP resources and prompt templates directly into agent context.
- ⚡ **Resilient Execution**: I"},{"id":"p7s20","text":"solated server lifecycles, per-server timeout controls, and non-blocking error handling.
- 🏷️ **Clea"},{"id":"p7s21","text":"n Namespacing**: Automatic tool name prefixing (`github_create_issue`, `postgres_query`) to avoid na"},{"id":"p7s22","text":"me collisions across servers.
